title: MissDiag: Diagnostic Evaluation of Incomplete-Knowledge Robustness in KGQA and KG-RAG
abstract: arXiv:2608.18489v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) and knowledge-graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (KG-RAG) aim to ground answers in explicit graph evidence, but real-world knowledge graphs are often sparse, outdated, and incomplete. Existing robustness evaluations usually report aggregate changes in answer quality after evidence is removed or perturbed, which measures sensitivity to incomplete support but leaves the source of degradation under-specified: the same score change can conflate the type of missing evidence, the response of the evaluated system, and the sensitivity of the answer-matching protocol. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{MissDiag}, a diagnostic evaluation framework for incomplete-knowledge robustness in KGQA and KG-RAG. translated_title: MissDiag：知识图谱问答与知识图谱增强生成中不完整知识鲁棒性的诊断评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18489v1 公告类型：新 摘要：知识图谱问答（KGQA）和基于知识图谱的检索增强生成（KG-RAG）旨在将答案基于显式图证据，但现实世界的知识图谱往往稀疏、过时且不完整。现有的鲁棒性评估通常报告在移除或扰动证据后答案质量的总体变化，这衡量了对不完整支持的敏感性，但未明确性能下降的来源：相同的分数变化可能混淆缺失证据的类型、被评估系统的响应以及答案匹配协议的敏感性。为解决这一差距，我们提出了\textbf{MissDiag}，一个用于KGQA和KG-RAG中不完整知识鲁棒性的诊断评估框架。MissDiag保持问题和金标准答案不变，同时对基准提供的支持图施加结构类型化的缺失干预，从而通过配对比较来分解鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出MissDiag框架，通过结构类型化的缺失干预和配对比较，将知识图谱问答与增强生成中不完整知识导致的性能下降分解为缺失证据类型、系统响应和匹配协议敏感性，从而提供更精细的诊断评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MissDiag, a diagnostic framework that decomposes performance degradation from incomplete knowledge in KGQA and KG-RAG into missing-evidence types, system responses, and matching-protocol sensitivity via structurally typed missingness interventions and paired comparisons.
